value.alignment_mechanism: EXACT STRING EQUALITY on entity_id -- not a parse, not a bridge row

evidence.denominator: 19482 entities in the ratified L2 STRUCTURE set at 64ae1ae879 -- the POPULATION's denominator, not the view's
evidence.instrument: git show 64ae1ae879:<L2 artifact> for the population; the served factorized artifact's population carrier for the view's ids; set comparison on the raw id strings
evidence.positive_control: the two id sets are compared BOTH ways: population-not-in-view = 0 and view-not-in-population = 0, so a one-sided match cannot masquerade as full alignment; and index order is checked element-wise (identical = True), which a set comparison alone would not catch
evidence.failure_look: a PARSE presented as an alignment (normalising case, stripping a prefix, or matching on a substring), or |aligned| reported against the VIEW's denominator so a view covering a fraction of the population reads as 100%

value.evaluator_carried: W(i,j) = numerator(i,j) / denominator, where numerator(i,j) = sum over r of 1 if partitions[r][i] == partitions[r][j] else 0
value.derivation: W(i,j) = numerator(i,j) / 25 where numerator(i,j) = the count of the 25 partitions placing i and j in the same block. The partitions are read from the SERVED artifact; index i is the position of the node id in the population carrier's node_ids (carrier sha256 b4231e6374ce4360, equal to the artifact's own population_carrier_digest). No SBM run, no producing-store write.

evidence.instrument: aws s3 cp of the immutable run-addressed URI, then sha256 over the bytes read
evidence.positive_control: the resolved bytes hash to e91d69910fc9d4ea, byte-equal to the sha256 the L2 record declares, AND the artifact's population_carrier_digest equals the sha256 of the carrier actually read -- two independent digest checks, either of which would fail on a substituted artifact
evidence.failure_look: re-running the producer and calling the result the served view (cert arm 1), or applying the evaluator to partitions whose index order is not the carrier's -- which yields a well-formed matrix about the wrong nodes

value.why_zero_absent: REQUIRED BY THE ROW WHEN ABSENT IS 0. It is 0 by CONSTRUCTION, not by luck: the view's id list IS the population (exact-string 1:1 and index-identical, see population_binding), and every one of the 19482 entities carries a block label in ALL 25 partitions, so every entity participates in the pair domain. An entity could only be ABSENT here if it were in the population and missing from the carrier -- measured at 0.
value.node_level_scalar_is_absent_by_design: the L2 record carries features.consensus_affinity=ABSENT on all 19482 entities; per the L2 consumer_contract that denotes the intentionally undefined NODE-LEVEL scalar annotation, NOT missing pairwise coverage. The two are different claims and collapsing them would understate this view.

evidence.instrument: per-entity features census over the L2 record + per-partition label presence over the served partitions
evidence.positive_control: the label-presence test is run over all 25 partitions rather than one, so a view covered in some runs and not others would surface as a count below 19482; it reads 19482
evidence.failure_look: reporting ABSENT as 0 affinity. A zero asserts LOW affinity and an ABSENT asserts NO EVIDENCE; collapsing them is the failure PRD sec 3 L3 names, and it would be invisible in a matrix that looks complete

evidence.denominator: 189764421 pairs = C(19482,2), the complete pair domain
evidence.instrument: RE-DERIVED at this seat over THIS population by blockwise signature-agreement over the 25 partitions -- a DIFFERENT method from the producer's pair-key reduction. The L2 number is NOT inherited: the row requires view 1 to re-state its gate over this population, and it is re-stated.
evidence.positive_control: pairs counted 189764421 of 189764421 expected -> COMPLETE, so the value census covers the whole domain rather than a sample; and the re-derived histogram equals the artifact's published numerator_histogram (True), which is a second instrument agreeing on the same object by a different route
evidence.failure_look: citing the L2 gate's 26 values instead of re-deriving them -- a BORROWED gate, which this row makes a refusal; or a single distinct value / all-pairs-equal, which is the C3.i shape this gate exists to catch
evidence.could_have_differed_why: the statistic is a count of DISTINCT values over the complete domain; a constant matrix would return 1 and FAIL. It returns 26 spanning 0..25, with 149470800 pairs at 0 and 1685258 at full consensus -- the two extremes are both populated, so the gate is not passing on a degenerate distribution.
evidence.rule: PASS only if at least two distinct affinity values exist with neither all-pairs-0 nor all-pairs-1

value.prd_numbers_are_not_the_comparison: PRD sec 6.3's 0.989 / 0.974 were measured on DIFFERENT single views and are NOT the comparison for this number. This row SUPPLIES one of the two per-view baselines 6.3 needs; 6.3 is discharged only when both baselines and the fused output exist. Nothing here claims 6.3.
value.firm_label_basis: INFERRED, not measured: NO entity record in the L2 population carries a firm field (entity keys are entity_id, node_type, layer, features). The firm is recovered by a word-boundary token parse of the entity_id, which is the same 'recoverable only by parsing an id' class this lane typed as `inferred` on arn_to_service in wave 1. A consumer must not read this baseline as resting on a declared firm.

evidence.denominator: 1941 labelled entities of 19482 in the population (10.0%); pair frame 1882770 = C(1941,2)
evidence.instrument: word-boundary regex for bd|inf|mdpf over entity_id, then within- vs cross-firm mean W over the served partitions
evidence.positive_control: PERMUTATION CONTROL, executed: shuffling the firm labels collapses the separation from 0.167169 to -0.000716 (within 0.109094 vs cross 0.109810). The statistic therefore measures the firm boundary and not the graph's general density -- without this arm a large separation could be an artefact of any grouping.
evidence.failure_look: reporting the separation against the LABELLED subset as though it were the population -- 17541 of 19482 entities carry no firm token at all and are ABSENT for this baseline, not zero; or a separation that survives label permutation, which would mean the number is not about firms
